results.title: BRICS, the Worlds New Masterminds?
results.original_title: Chine, Russie, Inde et Co, nouveaux maîtres du monde ?
results.overview: The BRICS countries now represent half of the world's population and 40% of GDP. Seen by some as an anti-Western coalition and by others as an economic counterweight, the BRICS are gaining momentum in their desire to impose a new world order. For now, they are maneuvering to "de-dollarize" the global economy and rally as many countries in the "global South" as possible to their model. Tomorrow, will they succeed in supplanting Western institutions and values with their parallel organizations, or will Europe manage to rebalance the playing field?

results.title: Etudes of Consciousness
results.overview: Three surrealist études explore the inner world of a human being: a man on the metro struggles against obsessive forces, a young girl loses her balance under her mother’s pressure, and a boy confronts Anxiety but friendship helps him overcome it. Stories about fear, loneliness, and support.

results.title: City
results.overview: An animated reflection on the role of the individual in the ever-changing urban landscape, drawing on Mykhailo Semenko’s futuristic poetry and the realities of contemporary Ukraine.

results.title: StarFall
results.overview: The little star descends toward the earth, bound to a journey it knows will end in ruin. The distant stars pleading for its return are the echoes of reason—an internal warning it chooses to ignore. Just as stars vanish from our sight with the dawn, the protagonist fades away with the first light of day, unable to exist in a world where he was never meant to belong.

results.title: MOTH
results.overview: In a dark wardrobe, in the land of moths, a dictator is dying! But only you will know how the stubborn little bug will finally be crushed, and by whom.

results.title: The Last Summer Camp
results.overview: Two best friends have spent every summer at the same summer camp. Now it’s their last one, and they both know nothing will ever be the same again. As part of their camp duties, they are ordered to destroy an anthill. A heated argument stops the job and before they can make up, thousands of ants swarm in, ready for revenge...
